spec2def(msimg32.dll msimg32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# msimg32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msimg32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(msimg32_shims OBJECT msimg32_main.c)
target_link_libraries(msimg32_shims PRIVATE wine libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(msimg32_shims)
add_cargo_module(msimg32 msimg32-cargo msimg32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msimg32_shims psdk)
